_help: What she says about her memories. {memory} is the remembered thing, {system} the place, {hours} and {count} are numbers. _Login lines are used in the login greeting, _Ask lines when you say 'what do you remember'. A _Mood suffix (for example Memory_Death_Login_Sarcastic) is used only in that mood.
Memory_Empty: I haven't got much to remember yet, Commander. Give me time.
Not a lot yet. We've only just started.
Memory_Hours: That's {hours} hours of flying with you so far.
Memory_Destroyed: You've lost your ship {count} times. I counted.
I've watched you get destroyed {count} times.
Memory_ForgetHow: If you want me to forget, open the Memory page on the dashboard. I won't wipe it by voice, in case it was a mistake.
Memory_Record_Ask: There's {memory}. I'm proud of that one.
Memory_Death_Login: Try to stay alive this time. I haven't forgotten: {memory}.
I remember when it went wrong. {memory}.
Memory_Death_Login_Sarcastic: Let's not repeat the last time. {memory}.
Do try to avoid being destroyed again. {memory}.
Memory_Death_Ask: I remember the bad ones too. {memory}.
{memory}. I try not to dwell on it.
